question.nlq: I would like to know the number of distinct users who received a badge named 'Teacher' before 2011-01-01 and have posted at least one comment with a score greater than 60, and I also request the average number of such high‑scoring comments per these users.

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH badge_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UserId
    FROM badges
    WHERE Name = 'Teacher' AND Date < '2011-01-01'
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT bu.UserId, COUNT(*) AS high_comment_cnt
    FROM badge_users bu
    JOIN comments c ON c.UserId = bu.UserId
    WHERE c.Score > 60
    GROUP BY bu.UserId
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS distinct_user_count,
    AVG(high_comment_cnt) AS avg_high_scoring_comments_per_user
FROM qualified;

question.nlq: Could you please list the display names of users with a reputation exceeding 500 who have earned at least two distinct badge names after January 1, 2011, along with the average number of days between each of their consecutive badge earnings during that period, sorted by this average duration from shortest to longest?

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH filtered_badges AS (
    SELECT 
        b.UserId,
        b.Name,
        b.Date,
        u.DisplayName
    FROM badges b
    JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
    WHERE b.Date > '2011-01-01'
      AND u.Reputation > 500
),
distinct_badge_users AS (
    SELECT 
        UserId,
        DisplayName,
        COUNT(DISTINCT Name) as distinct_badge_count
    FROM filtered_badges
    GROUP BY UserId, DisplayName
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Name) >= 2
),
ranked_badges AS (
    SELECT 
        fb.UserId,
        fb.DisplayName,
        fb.Date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fb.UserId ORDER BY fb.Date) as rn
    FROM filtered_badges fb
    INNER JOIN distinct_badge_users dbu ON fb.UserId = dbu.UserId
),
badge_gaps AS (
    SELECT 
        r1.UserId,
        r1.DisplayName,
        julianday(r2.Date) - julianday(r1.Date) as days_diff
    FROM ranked_badges r1
    JOIN ranked_badges r2 
        ON r1.UserId = r2.UserId 
        AND r2.rn = r1.rn + 1
),
user_avg_gaps AS (
    SELECT 
        UserId,
        DisplayName,
        AVG(days_diff) as avg_days
    FROM badge_gaps
    GROUP BY UserId, DisplayName
)
SELECT 
    DisplayName,
    avg_days
FROM user_avg_gaps
ORDER BY avg_days ASC

turns.sql:
WITH filtered_badges AS (
    SELECT UserId, Name, Date
    FROM badges
    WHERE Date > '2011-01-01'
),
user_badges AS (
    SELECT b.UserId, b.Name, b.Date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.UserId ORDER BY b.Date) AS rn
    FROM filtered_badges b
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT cur.UserId,
           (julianday(cur.Date) - julianday(prev.Date)) AS gap_days
    FROM user_badges cur
    JOIN user_badges prev
      ON cur.UserId = prev.UserId
     AND cur.rn = prev.rn + 1
),
avg_gap AS (
    SELECT UserId,
           AVG(gap_days) AS avg_days_between
    FROM gaps
    GROUP BY UserId
),
qualified_users AS (
    SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName
    FROM users u
    JOIN (
        SELECT UserId
        FROM filtered_badges
        GROUP BY UserId
        HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Name) >= 2
    ) b ON u.Id = b.UserId
    WHERE u.Reputation > 500
)
SELECT qu.DisplayName,
       ag.avg_days_between
FROM qualified_users qu
LEFT JOIN avg_gap ag ON qu.Id = ag.UserId
ORDER BY ag.avg_days_between ASC;

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT b.UserId, b.Name, b.Date
    FROM badges b
    JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
    WHERE u.Reputation > 500
      AND b.Date >= '2011-01-01'
),
distinct_check AS (
    SELECT UserId
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY UserId
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Name) >= 2
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT f.UserId,
           f.Name,
           f.Date,

    FROM filtered f
    WHERE f.UserId IN (SELECT UserId FROM distinct_check)
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT UserId,
           (julianday(Date) - julianday(prev_date)) AS gap_days
    FROM ordered
    WHERE prev_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT u.DisplayName,
       AVG(g.gap_days) AS avg_days_between_badges
FROM gaps g
JOIN users u ON g.UserId = u.Id

WITH filtered_badges AS (
    SELECT b.UserId, b.Name, b.Date
    FROM badges b

),
user_badge_counts AS (

),
user_badge_intervals AS (
    SELECT
        fb.UserId,

    FROM filtered_badges fb
    JOIN user_badge_counts ubc ON fb.UserId = ubc.UserId
),
intervals AS (

        UserId,
        (julianday(Date) - julianday(prev_date)) AS days_between
    FROM user_badge_intervals

),
avg_interval AS (
    SELECT UserId, AVG(days_between) AS avg_days

SELECT

FROM users u
JOIN avg_interval ON u.Id = avg_interval.UserId
WHERE u.Reputation > 500
ORDER BY avg_interval.avg_days ASC;

with filtered as (

),

    FROM badges b
    WHERE b.Date >= '2011-01-01'

    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.Name) >= 2
),
badge_with_prev AS (

WITH filtered_badges AS (
    SELECT 
        b.UserId,
        b.Name AS BadgeName,
        b.Date AS BadgeDate
    FROM badges b
    JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
    WHERE u.Reputation > 500

),
user_distinct_badge_count AS (

),
date_differences AS (

    WHERE u.Reputation > 500
    GROUP BY u.Id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT curr.Name) >= 2

           (julianday(Date) - julianday(prev_date)) AS diff_days
    FROM ordered
    WHERE prev_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT d.UserId,
       d.DisplayName,
       AVG(diff_days) AS avg_days_between_badges
FROM diffs d
JOIN (
    SELECT UserId
    FROM user_badges
    GROUP BY UserId
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Name) >= 2
) eligible ON eligible.UserId = d.UserId
GROUP BY d.UserId, d.DisplayName
ORDER BY avg_days_between_badges ASC;
